decision: Owner-approved 2026-10-09 (via scheduler): production tenant glue configuration = real-embedding calibration of NX-045. Applied only through trusted configuration (nexloop_configurator). CI keeps tests/data/nx045_merge_config.json (test embedding).

calibration.method: grid search, weight step 0.1 over the simplex, thresholds 0.300..0.900 step 0.025; whitelist weight >= threshold; objective: precision 1.0, then recall, then margin

notes: whitelist is empty: the calibration's two whitelist pairs are synthetic; a business whitelist is owner-provided and needs a new config_version
the configuration is only valid for the embedding profile it was calibrated on; publishing is refused unless it is the tenant's active recall profile
dedupe_threshold equals merge_threshold (same features, same calibration)
